reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that replaces text session statistics with an auto-refreshing chart panel and optionally displays estimated cost and account balance.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的会话统计替换为每秒刷新的右侧图表面板，并可显示估算花费与账户余额。
summaries.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness text session statistics with a right-side chart panel that refreshes every second and can show estimated cost and account balance.

capabilities: Displays session turns, steps, timing, token usage, cache, and context metrics in a right-side chart panel
Refreshes displayed session metrics every second
Estimates session cost from token usage and configured pricing
Reads DeepSeek account balance through the DeepSeek balance API using the configured API key
